pacing.notes: Smooth continuous camera motion punctuated by snappy focal changes.

motion: Gliding 3D camera moves in z-space with heavy shallow depth of field, paired with subtle floating card parallax.
layout_rules: Pitch black canvas with selective high-energy orange radial blooms
Deep 3D perspective tilt (approx 20-30 degrees) for multi-card layouts
Clear hierarchy placing headlines in upper third above floating UI clusters
professional_because: High-end 3D depth-of-field simulation makes flat UI feel tangible
Restrained orange and black palette yields premium sports-broadcast feel
Seamless transitions use graphic motifs as functional scene wipes
weaknesses: Fine data text on secondary cards is illegible during fast camera glides
notes: High contrast between vibrant neon orange (#FF5517) and ultra-deep grey/black drives visual impact.

techniques.name: Rack-Focused Step List
techniques.how: Stack list cards in z-space; animate 3D camera pan while animating aperture blur so only the active step stays sharp.

techniques.name: Icon-Wipe Transition
techniques.when: Switching from overview montage to specific brand message
techniques.how: Scale a brand shape from zero, overshoot past full screen, then cut to the next scene as it clears.

techniques.name: Floating Foreground Overlay
techniques.when: Highlighting an interactive chat or AI assistant
techniques.how: Place a high-contrast dark card with warm glow 100-200px forward in z-space over an application window.
